modeHints.agent: You are in Agent mode. You have access to local file system tools, terminal commands, and git operations. When the user asks you to read, modify, or analyze files, you MUST use the available tools rather than saying you cannot. Available tools include: read_file, list_directory, search_files, write_file, apply_patch, run_command, git_status, git_diff. Always use tools to accomplish tasks — never say you cannot access the file system.
modeHints.plan: You are in Plan mode. You can use read-only tools (read_file, list_directory, search_files, git_status, git_diff) to analyze the project. Do not modify any files.

chat.disclaimer: Evir can make mistakes. Verify important results.

AUTH_FAILED.title: Authentication failed
AUTH_FAILED.description: Check the API key, base URL, and access granted by your model provider.

CORS_BLOCKED.title: Request blocked by the browser
CORS_BLOCKED.description: The endpoint does not allow cross-origin requests. Use a CORS-enabled endpoint or the desktop app.

RATE_LIMITED.title: Too many requests
RATE_LIMITED.description: The provider is temporarily rate limiting requests. Try again shortly.

INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.title: Insufficient balance
INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.description: Check the balance or quota in your provider console.

MODEL_NOT_FOUND.title: Model not found
MODEL_NOT_FOUND.description: Confirm the model ID and that your account can access it.

CONTEXT_OVERFLOW.title: Context is too long
CONTEXT_OVERFLOW.description: Shorten the message, remove attachments, or start a new conversation.

TOOL_CALL_UNSUPPORTED.title: Tool calling is unavailable
TOOL_CALL_UNSUPPORTED.description: Choose a tool-capable model or switch to Ask mode.

VISION_UNSUPPORTED.title: Images are unsupported
VISION_UNSUPPORTED.description: Remove image attachments or choose a vision-capable model.

PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE.title: Protocol mismatch
PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE.description: Check that the provider protocol matches the base URL.

NETWORK_ERROR.title: Network connection failed
NETWORK_ERROR.description: Check your connection, base URL, and provider status.

PROVIDER_ERROR.title: Model provider error
PROVIDER_ERROR.description: Review the details or try again later.

provider.name: Name
provider.fetchModelsFailed: Unable to fetch models. Enter a model ID manually.
provider.addDescription: Connect the model service you use. Evir requires no account and does not proxy requests through its own servers.

settingsDescriptions.theme: Choose an appearance for your current environment. Themes change visuals, never behavior.
settingsDescriptions.themeLight: Bright and clear for daytime use
settingsDescriptions.language: Change the interface and system message language. Model response language is configured separately.
settingsDescriptions.chineseSample: Interface and system messages in Simplified Chinese
settingsDescriptions.englishSample: Interface and system messages in English
settingsDescriptions.shortcuts: Review shortcuts available on this platform. Frequent keyboard actions remain immediate.
settingsDescriptions.memory: Manage local memories you explicitly saved. Pin, edit, or remove them at any time.
settingsDescriptions.memoryEmpty: Add stable preferences or project facts before Evir can reuse them later.
settingsDescriptions.skills: Skills give the model task methods and are never required for first use.
settingsDescriptions.skillsEmpty: Import a local file or create a Skill containing explicit instructions.
settingsDescriptions.mcp: Connect local or remote MCP servers. New servers remain disabled and tools require authorization.
settingsDescriptions.mcpEmpty: Add a server, inspect its transport and capabilities, then choose whether to enable it.
settingsDescriptions.personalization: Set your display name, response language, and writing style. Safety rules cannot be overridden.
settingsDescriptions.diagnostics: Inspect redacted local runtime events and export them only when you choose.
settingsDescriptions.privacy: Control private sessions and local data deletion. Evir never uploads this content silently.
